author: Dion Vantyler
text:
★★★★★

Used Sewer Works LLC this past winter to have my septic tank pumped. They showed up as scheduled, got the job done, and were very easy to work with. Straightforward, reliable service and an excellent experience overall. I’d gladly use them again.

author: Brian Schmitz
text: We had an emergency where our pump failed and our tanks were full and backing up.  Sewer Works came at the end of the work day, after all their other appointments and pumped our tanks until 7:30 at night in the dark!    They go above and beyond.  They have fair prices and great customer service.

author: Gregory Roeder
text: If you own a septic system and ever have issues, be sure to call Jeff Peterson with Sewer works! He is very knowledgeable and honest.I had grey water coming out of a pipe.  Another company wanted to charge me almost a 1000.00 for camera scope and jet flushing. Jeff walked me through my whole system, checking for any issues. Then decided it was a loose cap and switched it out for me. Didn’t cost me a thing, except the cap which was too big! Thanks again Jeff!

author: Mike Ulferts
text: These guys are great. Very knowledgeable, friendly, and affordable. You can tell they know what they are doing. I have been using them for close to a decade for septic maintenance now and they always do a great job and make sure our system is good to go. I would certainly recommend them to friends and family.

author: Jim Gookin
text: For many years we have had SewerWorks do routine maintenance, pump replacement and other services.  Our system is over 50 years old and time to be replaced. We wouldn't trust anyone else to design a system for us.
